reasons.c.integration: The gRPC C arm runs the integration harness against the changed core.
reasons.c.unit: C tests run the changed Rust consumer/producer/admin core through the FFI.
reasons.dotnet.grpc: The gRPC .NET arm runs the integration harness against the changed core.
reasons.dotnet.performance: Measures the changed consumer/producer path through the .NET binding.
reasons.dotnet.soak: The soak client exercises the changed consumer core.
reasons.dotnet.solution: .NET unit and integration tests run the changed Rust core via P/Invoke and the FFI.
reasons.python.grpc: The gRPC Python arm runs the integration harness against the changed core.
reasons.python.integration: Exercises the changed consumer/producer/admin core against a broker.
reasons.python.performance: Measures the changed consumer/producer path through the binding.
reasons.python.soak: Long-running Python clients exercise the changed consumer core.
reasons.python.unit: Python tests run the changed Rust core through _confluentkafka.c and the FFI.
reasons.python.verifiable_clients: Drives the changed core through the Python binding.
reasons.rust.admin: AdminClientConfig and AbstractConfig/abstract request-response code changed.
reasons.rust.chaos: Runs the changed consumer/producer core under fault injection.
reasons.rust.consumer: The consumer membership manager, heartbeat manager, network thread and async consumer were refactored.
reasons.rust.consumer-perf: Depends on the changed consumer core.
reasons.rust.doc: The new acknowledgement_commit_callback.rs adds a doc comment with a code block (a doctest).

reasons.rust.integrity: Runs the changed consumer/producer core end to end.
reasons.rust.lib: New share request/response, membership, heartbeat and config modules with unit tests, plus a refactored consumer membership/heartbeat/network-thread core and AbstractConfig hook signature used by every client config.
reasons.rust.performance: Exercises the changed consumer hot path (network thread, heartbeat, reconcile).
reasons.rust.producer: ProducerConfig and the shared AbstractConfig/abstract request-response code changed.
reasons.rust.verifiable-clients: Drives the changed Rust consumer and producer.
reasons.rust.xtask: xtask/src/java.rs gains a word substitution and ffi-baseline.txt changes.
